## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric ritual manual by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) for the One-Syllable Crown-Wheel-King practice in the *Vajraśekhara-yoga* framework — emphasizing the **all-times-and-places** (*yīqiè shíchù*) practical applicability of the practice. The text is one of the working portable Esoteric daily-practice manuals.

**Abstract**

The text gives a generalised, portable form of the One-Syllable Crown-Wheel-King practice, suitable for recitation at any time or place — distinct from the more elaborate context-specific ritual sequences of T954 / T955. The composition dates from Amoghavajra's mature Cháng'ān period (746–774).
